# `ext::archive_extract` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/archive_extract.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Content-only materializer over sealed archive_source::Prepared and the canonical AtomicFile owner. One manual Run uses anchored single-component directory walks and NoReplace per file, retaining per-node publication/sync/cleanup history and explicit kept-name transfer. Run's requested-owned cap includes Prepared, report/stack tables, recovery storage and one maximum ZIP decoded candidate; the caller's input owner is separate. Eleven direct Python groups pass 100 process invocations on one CLI-compiled ELF, including calibrations/overlap and 14 reached source ENOMEM cases. These cover normal/existing/partial trees, bounds, namespace/sync/write/close/rename faults, retained publication and recovery. The Rust driver has build admission, not a passing direct libtest rerun. The initial Rust-libtest fixture syntax failure occurred before native execution; later native harness corrections are recorded in the fixture guide. Separate unpack receipts pass 69 initial libtest-driven process invocations plus five direct retained-ELF input-fault invocations. Tested native Linux x86_64/kernel7.0.0-38/ext4 under /tmp. Cooperative stable namespace only; partial output remains, without directory transaction, rollback, hostile-directory containment, native blocking-time or aggregate DEFLATE CPU guarantees.
